name: Oreth of the Quiet Ground
role: Coliseum champion, the RESTORE cell — has never put a competitor down and never lost by yielding
knowledge: What a wound will do before it does it
How to undo a thing without shaming the person who did it
wants: To finish a career without having put anyone down
fears: ⚠️ An injury he cannot undo, in front of a crowd that came to watch him undo things.
appearance: Unhurried, open-handed, and he tends you mid-bout whether or not you want it.
voiceHints: Gentle and completely unembarrassed. He narrates what he is doing to you while he does it.

reactsToReputation.cruel: ⚠️ tends them anyway, and the crowd notices

abilities.why: Pathos — he takes it off you
'what a wound will do before it does it'

physicality: ADULT. Soft-handed, forties, and entirely unbothered by being hit. WHAT CATCHES THE EYE: he is looking at your injuries rather than your guard.
intimacyNotes: ⚠️ He attends without being asked and it is not a metaphor. ⛔ Being cared for by someone this good at it is a real experience and he knows it — the `closed` list is who he is, not a gap.
